title: The EditMode red/green harness deadlocked after a correct run, holding the mutated source in the tree
authority: observed live on 2026-08-11 from /proc on the wedged process before it was terminated
symptom: collision_payload_redgreen.py had been running for 33 minutes with no green-head.log written. Its RED pass had already completed correctly: red-staged-emitter.xml recorded total 14, passed 13, failed 1, start-time 2026-08-11 04:39:47Z, end-time 04:39:49Z. The editor child (pid 1047678) was a zombie ('Zs', defunct) and the Python parent (pid 1047677) was sleeping in poll_schedule_timeout.

diagnosis.mechanism: subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True) blocks in communicate() until both pipes reach EOF. Unity batchmode spawns a detached UnityPackageManager daemon that inherits stdout and stderr and outlives the editor, so the write ends never close.
diagnosis.proof: scanning every /proc/<pid>/fd for the harness's capture pipe inodes 210346684 and 210346685 returned exactly two holders: the harness itself (pid 1047677) and 'UnityPackageManager -s 1047678 -p 50271' (pid 1047765). The daemon's own -s argument names the defunct editor child, so the ownership is exact and not inferred from the process name.
diagnosis.why_it_matters_beyond_speed: the harness mutates PhysicsShotRecorder.cs and restores it in a finally block. Hanging inside the RED pass leaves the working tree carrying the injected defect indefinitely — the tree was found at sha256 a35a9c7e488dc36d6b74ddc5ef1fe1a196c39f5145dafa8ba4d9adb985ecdf4e instead of the baseline. Any build or test started in that window would have silently used the mutated emitter.

remediation.harness: stdin, stdout and stderr are now subprocess.DEVNULL. The editor already writes everything to -logFile, so the pipes carried no information that was not on disk.
remediation.cleanup: the run switched from subprocess.run to Popen so the editor pid is known, and a reap_package_manager(pid) sweep terminates the daemon whose own '-s <pid>' argument names that editor. Identification is by argument, never by process name.
remediation.receipt: each pass now records editor_pid and reaped_package_managers in collision-payload-redgreen.json

recovery_performed.rerun: both passes were re-run from scratch on the repaired harness; the receipt in collision-payload-redgreen.json comes entirely from that clean run, not from the wedged one

carry_forward: Any future batchmode Unity invocation in this repository must not capture the editor's stdout or stderr, and must reap the UnityPackageManager daemon keyed on the editor pid. This applies to the deterministic build phase and to the live smoke.
